PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-tutorial-descriptions: The Painterly Brush tool allows you to bring your unique ideas to life in all-new ways with impeccably realistic pixel-based brushes.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.tutorial-will-learn: In this tutorial, you will learn how to:
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.use-brush-selector: Use the brush selector and brush options.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.apply-brush-effects: Apply Painterly brush effects to curves.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.add-painterly-brush-effect: Add Painterly brush effects to text.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.painterly-brushes-effect-curves: You can use the Painterly brushes to apply effects to curves. Let’s try it!
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.practiec-file-pre-selected-painterl: In this practice file, the yellow curve is pre-selected for you and the Painterly Brush tool is activated.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.property-bar-brush-selector: The Property bar has a brush selector and controls for brush size and transparency.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-selector-dropdown: Start by clicking the brush selector dropdown and choosing the Silk Flower brush. The brush effect will be applied to the yellow curve.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-size-transparency: Next, change the brush size to 0.06” and the transparency to 20%.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-color-palette: Right-click on the Ice Blue color swatch on the Color palette to change the color.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.draw-new-brush-strokes: You can also draw new brush strokes from scratch.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.deselect-everything-page: Press the Esc key to deselect everything on the page. Then use the Property bar controls to:
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-color-swatch: Right-click on a color swatch to select a color.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.click-drag-jellyfish: Click and drag to draw another jellyfish arm, releasing the mouse button to finish the stroke.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.dont-worry-perfect: Don’t worry if it’s not perfect–we'll show you how to fix it in the next step.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.painterly-brush-strokes-reshaped: Painterly brush strokes can be reshaped just as you would with a line, shape or other object.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.activate-shape-tool-jellyfish: Activate the Shape tool from the Toolbox and click on the jellyfish arm you drew. You’ll see small nodes along the length of the arm.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.nodes-manipulated-with-shape-tool: These nodes can be manipulated with the Shape tool to change the shape of the arm. This works with brush strokes that have been applied to objects (like the yellow curve) as well as brush strokes created from scratch.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.pick-tool-move-resize-rotate: You can also use the Pick tool to move, resize, and rotate Painterly brush strokes.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.create-incredible-text-effects-pain: You can create some incredible text effects with the Painterly Brush tool.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.switch-back-painterly-brush: Switch back to the Painterly Brush tool by pressing the J shortcut key.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.click-ola-hello-text: Click on the “Ola Bonjour Hello” text to select it.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-white-swatch-change-col: Right-click the white swatch to change the color.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.mastered-basics-painterly-brush-too: You’ve mastered the basics of working with the Painterly Brush tool.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.learn-more-about-painterly-brush-to: Learn more about the Painterly Brush tool.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.get-started-full-cdgs: Get started with the full CorelDRAW Graphics Suite. Learn more.

FocusModeMiniCourse.text.focus-mode-course-descriptions: Focus Mode allows you to isolate design elements, making it easier to select and edit specific objects in complex documents.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.course-will-learn: In this course, you will learn:
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.bring-object-group: How to bring an object or group into Focus Mode.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.edit-temporary-group: How to edit in Focus Mode and work with temporary focus groups.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.ways-exit: Different ways to exit Focus Mode.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.customize-settings: How to customize Focus Mode settings.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.starting-group-multiple-nested-grou: We're starting with this sample file open and the Shelf Contents group, which contains multiple nested groups, is pre-selected for you.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.click-bring-into-focus-property-bar: To enter Focus Mode, click the Bring into Focus icon on the property bar.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.floating-toolbar-hierarchy-focus-mo: The floating toolbar displays the hierarchy and which object or group is in Focus Mode.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.fully-visible-editable-inactive-tra: The object or group in focus is fully visible and editable. Inactive objects are covered with a transparent overlay and cannot be selected or edited.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.drill-down-nested-groups-demonstrat: As we drill down through the nested groups, we'll demonstrate the other ways you can bring an object or group into focus.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.right-click-large-plant-bring-into-: Right-click on the large plant and select Bring into focus. This brings you to the Decor group, indicated on the floating toolbar.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.double-click-large-plant-into-focus: Double-click on the large plant to bring the Plant 1 group into focus.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.selecting-bring-into-focus-edit-men: You can also bring an object into focus by selecting Bring into Focus under the Edit menu.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.use-breadcrumbs-floating-toolbar-sh: Use the breadcrumbs on the floating toolbar to shift focus to other objects or groups in the hierarchy.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.single-object-focus-temporary: When you bring a single object into focus, it is placed in a temporary Focus group, which you can see on the floating toolbar and in the Objects docker.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.when-exit-focus-mode-temporary-disa: When you exit Focus Mode, the temporary Focus group will disappear UNLESS you've added a new object to it.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.edits-in-focus-mode-retained: Any edits you make to an object or group while in Focus Mode are retained when you exit.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.several-ways-to-exit: There are several ways to exit Focus Mode:
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.click-exit-floating-toolbar: Click the Exit Focus Mode icon on the floating toolbar or property bar.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.double-click-anywhere-drawing-windo: Double-click anywhere in the drawing window off the object or group in focus.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.edit-menu-exit-focus-mode: Under the Edit menu, select Exit Focus Mode.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.adjust-focus-mode-settings-path: To adjust Focus Mode settings, click Tools > Options > CorelDRAW.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.use-slider-adjust-transparency: Use the slider to adjust the transparency of the overlay for inactive objects.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.disable-double-click-to-activate: You can also disable the Double-click to activate Focus Mode setting.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.mastered-basics-focus-mode: You've mastered the basics of working in Focus Mode.
FocusModeMiniCourse.text.get-started-full-cdgs: Get started with the full CorelDRAW Graphics Suite. Learn more.

NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.templates-course-descriptions: CorelDRAW has hundreds of templates to help you get started quickly and easily.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.course-will-learn: In this course, you will learn:
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.how-access-open-templates: How to access and open templates.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.how-add-photos-graphics: How to add photos and graphics.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.access-and-open-templates: How to access and open templates
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.find-template-library-list: You'll find the online template library on the Templates tab of the New Document window. Use the Categories dropdown list to browse a variety of templates.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.select-brochures-category: Select the Brochures category. Click a thumbnail on the left to see a preview on the right.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.choose-skin-care-template: Choose the Skin Care Elixir Brochure template and click Open.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.templates-placeholder-text: Templates contain placeholder text that can be edited and formatted.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.activate-text-tool: Activate the Text tool and click and drag to highlight the text “Elixir Potion.”
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.type-new-text: Type new text to replace it.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.select-text-format-options: Select the text then click a color swatch on the color palette to change the text color and use the property bar settings to change the font, size, and other formatting options.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.design-elements-change-color: You can edit the design elements in various ways. For example, you can change the color scheme to match your brand colors.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.color-swatch-color-palette: Click a color swatch on the color palette to change the color.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.use-pick-tool-resize: Use the Pick tool to resize, rotate, or move the oval.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.use-shape-tool-modify: Use the Shape tool to modify the shape.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.add-photos-graphics: How to add photos and graphics
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.replace-graphics-photos: You can easily replace the graphics or sample photos with your own images, such as your company logo or product photos.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.use-file-import: First, use File > Import to bring in your photo or graphic.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.use-pick-tool-move-resize: Then use the Pick tool to move and resize the image as needed.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.templates-with-power-clip: Some templates have a sample photo inside a PowerClip frame that constrains it to a specific size and shape.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.import-image-file-import: Import your new image into the file using File > Import.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.drag-image-over-power-clip: Holding down your mouse button, drag the image over to the PowerClip frame and the frame will become highlighted.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.press-hold-k-key: Press and hold the K key to replace the sample image, then release the mouse button.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.image-will-place-inside-frame: Your image will be placed inside the frame and the PowerClip floating toolbar will appear.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.click-edit-button-power-clip: Click the Edit button on the PowerClip toolbar then use the Pick tool to resize, rotate, or move the photo inside the container.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.saving-new-template: When you've finished making changes to the template, you can save it as a new template, or another type of file.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.save-as-template: Use File > Save as Template to save as a new template. Choose a location on your computer to save and access the template for future use.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.file-save-as: Use File > Save as to save as a CDR file for future editing.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.file-export: Use File > Export to export as a JPG, PNG, PDF or other file format.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.mastered-basics-templates: You've mastered the basics of working with templates.
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.learn-more-about-templates: Learn more about working with templates
NewFromTemplateMiniCourse.text.get-started-full-cdgs: Get started with the full CorelDRAW Graphics Suite. Learn more.

CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.how-create-stickers-decals: How to create stickers and decals
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.create-stickers-own-photos-artwork: With CorelDRAW, you can create custom stickers and decals using your own photos or artwork. In this course, we’ll show you how to make  two different styles of stickers: a simple shape and a custom shape.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.print-stickers-sticker-sheets: You can print stickers at home on sticker sheets that are sold in a wide variety of shapes and sizes, or you can use a print shop or online print service for large quantities or custom shapes. Make sure you know the specifications before you start, such as color mode, file format, cut lines, etc.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.create-variety-shapes: You can create a variety of sticker shapes to match the dimensions of sticker sheets. We’re creating a 4” round sticker, but you can use the same process to create oval, square, or rectangular stickers.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.start-by-selecting-shape-tool: Start by selecting a shape tool from the toolbox—the Ellipse tool for circles and ovals or the Rectangle tool for squares and rectangles.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.click-and-drag-to-draw-shape: Click and drag to draw the shape.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.use-object-size-fields: Use the Object size fields on the property bar to adjust width and height fields (our circle is 4x4”).
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.press-to-center-shape-to-page: Press P to center the shape on the page.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.right-click-shape-order-back-to-pag: Right-click on the shape and choose Order > To Back of Page.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.click-color-swatch-fill-color: Click a color swatch on the color palette to fill the shape with color.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.change-default-outline: To change the default outline color, right-click a color swatch to change the outline color of the ellipse.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.thicker-outline-outline-pen-tool: If you want a thicker outline, double-click the Outline Pen icon on the status bar. Increase the Width and set the Position to Inside outline so the outline stays inside the page boundaries.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.remove-outline: To remove the outline, right-click the no-color swatch on the color palette or set the Width to None.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.switch-page-two: Switch to page two of the CorelDRAW file.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.create-custom-shape-contour-tool: To create a custom shape sticker, we’ll use the Contour tool to create a cut line around the design.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.create-boundary-entire-design: The first step is to create a boundary around the entire design.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.use-pick-tool-selection: Use the Pick tool to drag a selection marquee around all objects, including the text.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.press-to-group-all: Press Ctrl/Cmd + G to group them all together.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.boundary-shows-black-outline: The boundary shows as a black outline around each object.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.create-contour-from-boundary: The next step is to create a contour from the boundary.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.select-contour-tool-in-effects-tool: Select the Contour tool in the Effects tool group on the left toolbar.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.select-outside-contour-and-round-co: On the property bar, select Outside contour and Round corners.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.click-drag-square-handle-outward: Click and drag the square handle outward to create the boundary.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.blue-outline-preview-contour: The blue outline gives a preview of the contour as you’re drawing, including any holes that need to be removed. You can remove the holes by dragging the contour further outward until it is a solid shape, or by using the Shape tool as we’ll show in the next screen.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.boundary-to-create-contour: The boundary was only needed to create the contour so it can be deleted now.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.press-to-break-apart: Press Ctrl/Cmd + K to break apart the boundary and contour.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.select-boundary-pick-tool: Select the boundary with the Pick tool.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.optional-edit-contour: An optional step is to edit the contour. For example, we’d like to smooth out some lines and remove the holes above the text.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.select-shape-tool-contour-nodes: Select the Shape tool from the toolbox on the left, click on the contour, and nodes will appear. These nodes can be moved, manipulated, or deleted to change the shape of the contour.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.click-drag-middle-nodes: For example, click and drag to select the middle nodes along the bottom line…
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.then-press-delete-clean-line: … then press Delete and you’re left with a nice clean line.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.holes-to-remove-or-adjust: If there are holes to remove or other areas of the contour that you’d like to adjust, you can delete single or multiple nodes, or use the control handles to adjust the shape.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.print-at-home-test-page: If you’re printing at home on sticker sheets, print a test page first on regular paper to make sure the sticker design is properly aligned.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.print-shop-online-they-specify: If you are using a print shop or online print service, they will specify what outline properties are required so that the contour can be read as a cut line.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.change-outline-width-hairline: On the property bar, change the outline width to Hairline and right-click a color swatch to change the outline color to what your print shop specifies.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.mastered-created-own-custom-sticker: You’ve created your own custom sticker.
CreateStickerMiniCourse.text.get-started-full-cdgs: Get started with the full CorelDRAW Graphics Suite. Learn more.

CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.icon-simple-graphics-tools-create: Icons are simple graphics designed to represent an object, concept, or action. CorelDRAW has all the tools you need to create an icon, and it’s easier than you think!
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.course-show-watermelon: In this course, we’ll show you how to create a watermelon icon from two simple shapes.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.before-drawing-help-streamline: Before we start drawing, here are a couple things to help streamline your workflow.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.window-color-palettes-from-document: Under the Window menu, select Color Palettes > Add Colors from Document. This adds the colors in our sample design to the Document palette along the bottom of the interface, making it easy to add color fills and outlines.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.delete-colored-squares: You can now delete the five colored squares in the bottom right corner if you wish.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.view-alignment-guides-help: Under the View menu, make sure Alignment Guides are enabled to help you align and position objects.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.transforming-circle-pie-shape: Transforming a circle into a pie shape
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.pie-shaped-object-first-slice: We’ll start by transforming the circle into a pie-shaped object that is the first part of the watermelon slice.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.select-shape-click-circle: Select the Shape tool from the toolbox on the left and click on the circle. Click on the node at the top and drag to the left, making sure to keep your cursor inside the circle.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.dashed-line-preview-drag-trimmed: The blue dashed line gives you a preview as you’re dragging the node and when you release your mouse button the circle will be trimmed into a pie shape.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.switch-pick-tool-mirror: Switch to the Pick tool and click the Mirror vertically icon on the property bar.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.build-pie-object-slice: Next, we’ll build on the pie object to create a watermelon slice.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.duplicate-object-scale-factor: Press Ctrl/Cmd + D to duplicate the object and on the property bar, beside the Object size fields, change the Scale factor fields to 110%.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.pink-color-to-fill: Click the light pink color swatch on the Document palette to fill the second object.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.second-object-smart-duplicate: With the second object still selected, press Ctrl/Cmd + D to duplicate it. The Smart duplicate feature remembers the scale factor increase and applies it to this new object.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.green-color-third-object: Click the green color swatch to fill the third object. You should now have three pie-shaped objects:
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.green-order-back-page-pink-back-one: Right-click on the green object and select Order > To Back of Page. Then right-click on the light pink object and choose Order > Back One.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.pick-marquee-three-pie: With the Pick tool, click and drag to marquee-select all three pie objects.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.align-right-top-group: Press R to align right, T to align top, then Ctrl/Cmd + G to group them together.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.copy-group-paste-ctrl-drag: Press Ctrl/Cmd + C to copy the group, then Ctrl/Cmd + V to paste. Hold down the Ctrl key as you drag the left middle handle over to the right to create a full slice.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.ctrl-dark-pink-fill-red: Hold down the Ctrl key and select the dark pink object on the right and fill with red.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.to-finish-with-seeds: To finish off the watermelon icon we’ll add some seeds. Zoom in on the small green ellipse in the bottom left corner of the document.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.ellipse-shape-convert-curves: Select the ellipse with the Shape tool and click the Convert to curves icon on the property bar.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.select-top-node-point-tip-seed: Select the top node and drag the left or right arrow inward towards the node—this will create a point at the tip. Do the same with the bottom node and now we have a seed!
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.seed-order-front: Right-click on the seed and select Order > To Front of Page.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.pick-twice-more-seeds: Switch to the Pick tool and press Ctrl/Cmd + D twice to create two more seeds. Place them on the watermelon, using the alignment guides for precise positioning.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.success-icon-complete: Success! Your watermelon icon is complete.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.simplified-single-color: You can create a simplified, single-color version of the icon with a transparent background.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.pick-tool-all-black-swatch: Select all objects with the Pick tool. Right-click on the black swatch to change the outline color, then increase the Outline width on the property bar. Click the no-color swatch to remove the fill.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.virtual-segment-delete-solid-line: To remove the solid line in the middle, select the Virtual Segment Delete tool in the Crop tool group on the left toolbar then click on the line segments to remove them.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.virtual-segment-snaps-upright: The Virtual Segment Delete tool snaps upright when positioned properly.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.remove-small-gap-pick-tool: To get rid of the small gap at the top, use the Pick tool or arrow keys to nudge one of the slice groups towards the center.
CreateIconLogoMiniCourse.text.fill-seeds-smart-fill-tool: To fill the seeds, select them and click the black color swatch. To fill the rind, select the Smart Fill tool in the Fill tool group on the left toolbar, set the Fill color to black on the property bar, then click on one or both bottom curves to fill them.

PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-tutorial-descriptions: Das Hilfsmittel 'Malpinsel' stellt realistische, pixelbasierte Malwerkzeuge bereit, mit denen Sie Ihre einzigartigen Ideen auf ganz neue Art und Weise zum Leben erwecken können.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.tutorial-will-learn: In diesem Tutorial werden die folgenden Themen behandelt:
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.use-brush-selector: Die Pinselauswahl und die Pinseloptionen verwenden
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.painterly-brushes-effect-curves: Sie können mit den Malpinseln Effekte auf Kurven anwenden. Probieren wir es einfach aus!
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.practiec-file-pre-selected-painterl: In dieser Trainingsdatei ist die gelbe Kurve bereits für Sie ausgewählt und das Hilfsmittel 'Malpinsel' aktiviert.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.property-bar-brush-selector: Die Eigenschaftenleiste verfügt über eine Pinselauswahl sowie Steuerelemente für die Pinselgröße und -transparenz.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-selector-dropdown: Klicken Sie als Erstes auf das Pinselauswahl-Listenfeld und wählen Sie den Pinsel 'Seidenblume'. Der Pinseleffekt wird auf die gelbe Kurve angewendet.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-size-transparency: Ändern Sie als Nächstes die Pinselgröße auf 0,06” und die Transparenz auf 20 %.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-color-palette: Rechtsklicken Sie in der Farbpalette auf das Farbfeld 'Eisblau', um die Farbe zu ändern.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.draw-new-brush-strokes: Sie können auch neue Pinselstriche auftragen.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.deselect-everything-page: Drücken Sie die Esc-Taste, um die Auswahl aller Elemente auf der Seite aufzuheben. Verwenden Sie dann die Steuerelemente in der Eigenschaftenleiste, um:
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.set-brush-size: die Pinselgröße auf den Wert 0,06 zu setzen
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-color-swatch: Rechtsklicken Sie auf ein Farbfeld, um eine Farbe auszuwählen.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.click-drag-jellyfish: Klicken und ziehen Sie, um einen weiteren Quallenarm zu zeichnen. Lassen Sie die Maustaste los, um den Pinselstrich zu beenden.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.dont-worry-perfect: Keine Sorge, wenn der Strich noch nicht perfekt geraten ist – wir zeigen Ihnen im nächsten Schritt, wie Sie ihn korrigieren können.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.painterly-brush-strokes-reshaped: Malpinselstriche können auf gleiche Weise umgeformt werden wie eine Linie, eine Form oder ein anderes Objekt.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.activate-shape-tool-jellyfish: Aktivieren Sie in der Hilfsmittelpalette das Hilfsmittel 'Form' und klicken Sie auf den Quallenarm, den Sie gezeichnet haben. Entlang des Armes werden kleine Knoten angezeigt.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.nodes-manipulated-with-shape-tool: Diese Knoten können mit dem Hilfsmittel 'Form' bearbeitet werden, um die Form des Armes zu ändern. Dies funktioniert sowohl mit Pinselstrichen, die auf Objekte angewendet wurden (wie die gelbe Linie), als auch mit Pinselstrichen, die neu erstellt wurden.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.pick-tool-move-resize-rotate: Sie können Malpinselstriche mit dem Hilfsmittel 'Auswahl' auch verschieben, vergrößern, verkleinern und drehen.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.create-incredible-text-effects-pain: Mit dem Hilfsmittel 'Malpinsel' lassen sich einzigartige Texteffekte erzeugen.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.switch-back-painterly-brush: Wechseln Sie zurück zum Hilfsmittel 'Malpinsel', indem Sie das Tastenkürzel J drücken.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.click-ola-hello-text: Klicken Sie auf den Text „Ola Bonjour Hello“, um ihn auszuwählen.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.using-property-bar-controls: Unter Verwendung der Steuerelemente in der Eigenschaftenleiste:
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-white-swatch-change-col: Rechtsklicken Sie auf das weiße Farbfeld, um die Farbe zu ändern.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.mastered-basics-painterly-brush-too: Sie haben die Grundlagen des Hilfsmittels 'Malpinsel' gemeistert.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.ready-subscribe: Sind Sie bereit, ein Abo abzuschließen?

PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.skill-level-duration: 教程 • 新手 • %min 分钟
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-tutorial-descriptions: 绘画笔刷工具凭借无可挑剔地基于像素的逼真笔刷效果，以全新方式将您的独特创意变为现实。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.tutorial-will-learn: 在本教程中，您将学习如何：
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.use-brush-selector: 使用笔刷选择器和笔刷选项。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.apply-brush-effects: 在曲线上应用绘画笔刷效果。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.add-painterly-brush-effect: 添加绘画笔刷效果至文本。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.painterly-brushes-effect-curves: 您可以使用绘画笔刷来给曲线添加效果。试试看吧！
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.practiec-file-pre-selected-painterl: 在这个练习文件中，已预先选择黄色曲线，并且已启用绘画笔刷工具。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.property-bar-brush-selector: “属性栏”中有一个笔刷选择器以及相关控件，可用于调整笔刷大小和透明度。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-selector-dropdown: 首先单击笔刷选择器下拉菜单，选择“丝绸花”笔刷。此笔刷效果将应用于黄色曲线。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-size-transparency: 然后将笔刷大小改为 0.06”，透明度改为 20%。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-color-palette: 右键单击“调色板”上的“冰蓝色”色样来更改颜色。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.draw-new-brush-strokes: 您也可以重新绘制新的笔触。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.deselect-everything-page: 按 Esc 键取消选择页面上的所有内容。然后使用“属性栏”控件：
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-color-swatch: 右键单击一个色样，选择颜色。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.click-drag-jellyfish: 单击并拖动可绘制另一条水母触角，松开鼠标按钮即可完成绘制。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.dont-worry-perfect: 不要担心绘制效果不够完美，我们将在下一步向您展示如何进行调整。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.painterly-brush-strokes-reshaped: 绘画笔触可以重塑，就像您重塑一条线、一个形状或其他对象一样。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.activate-shape-tool-jellyfish: 启用工具箱中的“形状”工具，单击您已绘制的水母触角。此时会看到沿着触角的小节点。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.nodes-manipulated-with-shape-tool: 您可以通过“形状”工具调整这些节点，以此来改变触角的形状。这适用于已经应用于对象的笔触（如黄色曲线）以及新建的笔触。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.pick-tool-move-resize-rotate: 您也可以使用“选取”工具来移动、旋转绘画笔触并调整其大小。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.create-incredible-text-effects-pain: 您可以借助绘画笔刷工具创建一些令人惊艳的文字效果。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.switch-back-painterly-brush: 按快捷键 J 切换回绘画笔刷工具。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.click-ola-hello-text: 单击文本“Ola Bonjour Hello”来进行选择。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-white-swatch-change-col: 右键单击白色色样来更改颜色。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.mastered-basics-painterly-brush-too: 您已经掌握了使用绘画笔刷工具的基础知识。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.learn-more-about-painterly-brush-to: 了解有关绘画笔刷工具的更多信息。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.get-started-full-cdgs: 开始使用全套 CorelDRAW Graphics Suite。了解更多信息。

PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.explore-painterly-brush-tool: Explore a ferramenta Pincel com efeito de pintura
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-tutorial-descriptions: A ferramenta Pincel com efeito de pintura permite que você dê vida às suas ideias únicas de maneiras totalmente novas, com pincéis baseados em pixels impecavelmente realistas.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.use-brush-selector: Usar o seletor de pincel e as opções de pincel.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.apply-brush-effects: Aplicar efeitos de Pincel com efeito de pintura a curvas.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.create-new-painterly-brush: Criar pinceladas com efeito de pintura.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.add-painterly-brush-effect: Adicionar efeitos de Pincel com efeito de pintura a texto.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.painterly-brushes-effect-curves: Você pode usar os pincéis com efeito de pintura para aplicar efeitos a curvas. Vamos tentar!
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.practiec-file-pre-selected-painterl: Neste arquivo de prática, a curva amarela vem pré-selecionada e a ferramenta Pincel com efeito de pintura está ativada.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.property-bar-brush-selector: A barra de propriedades tem um seletor de pincel e controles de tamanho e de transparência do pincel.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.applying-painterly-brush-effects: Aplicar efeitos de Pincel com efeito de pintura
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-selector-dropdown: Comece clicando no menu suspenso do seletor de pincel e escolhendo o pincel Flor de seda. O efeito de pincel será aplicado à curva amarela.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-size-transparency: Em seguida, altere o tamanho do pincel para 1,52 mm e a transparência para 20%.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-color-palette: Clique com o botão direito do mouse na amostra de cor azul-gelo na paleta de cores para alterar a cor.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.creating-painterly-brush-strokes: Criar pinceladas com efeito de pintura
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.draw-new-brush-strokes: Você também pode desenhar novas pinceladas do zero.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.deselect-everything-page: Pressione a tecla Esc para desmarcar tudo na página. Em seguida, use os controles da barra de propriedades para:
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.select-silk-flower-brush: Selecionar o pincel Flor de seda.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.set-brush-size: Definir o tamanho do pincel como 1,52 mm.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-color-swatch: Clique com o botão direito do mouse em uma amostra de cor para selecionar uma cor.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.click-drag-jellyfish: Clique e arraste para desenhar outro tentáculo da medusa e solte o botão do mouse para finalizar a pincelada.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.dont-worry-perfect: Não se preocupe se não ficar perfeito. Mostraremos como corrigir na próxima etapa.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.reshaping-painterly-brush-stroke: Mudar a forma de uma pincelada com efeito de pintura
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.painterly-brush-strokes-reshaped: É possível mudar a forma de pinceladas com efeito de pintura da mesma maneira que você faria com uma linha, uma forma ou outro objeto.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.activate-shape-tool-jellyfish: Ative a ferramenta Forma na caixa de ferramentas e clique no tentáculo da medusa que você desenhou. Você verá pequenos nós ao longo do tentáculo.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.nodes-manipulated-with-shape-tool: Esses nós podem ser manipulados com a ferramenta Forma para alterar a forma do tentáculo. Isso funciona com as pinceladas que foram aplicadas a objetos (como a curva amarela), bem como com as pinceladas criadas do zero.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.pick-tool-move-resize-rotate: Você também pode usar a ferramenta Seleção para mover, redimensionar e girar pinceladas com efeito de pintura.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.adding-painterly-effects-text: Adicionar efeitos de Pincel com efeito de pintura a texto
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.create-incredible-text-effects-pain: É possível criar alguns efeitos de texto incríveis com a ferramenta Pincel com efeito de pintura.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.switch-back-painterly-brush: Pressione a tecla de atalho J para voltar à ferramenta Pincel com efeito de pintura.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.click-ola-hello-text: Clique no texto “Ola Bonjour Hello” para selecioná-lo.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.using-property-bar-controls: Use os controles da barra de propriedades para:
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.choose-the-fairy-dush-brush: Escolher o pincel Pó de fada.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.change-brush-size: Alterar o tamanho do pincel para 2,54 mm.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-white-swatch-change-col: Clique com o botão direito do mouse na amostra de branco para alterar a cor.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.mastered-basics-painterly-brush-too: Você aprendeu as noções básicas de como trabalhar com a ferramenta Pincel com efeito de pintura.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.learn-more-about-painterly-brush-to: Saiba mais sobre a ferramenta Pincel com efeito de pintura.

PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.use-brush-selector: Usar el selector de pincel y las opciones de pincel

PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.property-bar-brush-selector: La barra de propiedades tiene un selector de pincel y controles de tamaño y transparencia de pincel.

PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-size-transparency: A continuación, cambia el tamaño del pincel a 1,52 mm y la transparencia a 20 %.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-color-palette: Haz clic con el botón secundario en la muestra de color azul hielo de la paleta de colores para cambiar el color.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.creating-painterly-brush-strokes: Crear nuevas pinceladas de Pincel pictórico
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.draw-new-brush-strokes: También puedes crear nuevas pinceladas desde cero.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.deselect-everything-page: Presiona la tecla Esc para anular la selección de todo en la página. A continuación, usa los controles de la barra de propiedades para:
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.select-silk-flower-brush: Seleccionar el pincel Flor de seda
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.set-brush-size: Establecer el tamaño del pincel en 1,52 mm
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-color-swatch: Haz clic con el botón secundario en una muestra de color para seleccionar un color.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.click-drag-jellyfish: Haz clic y arrastra para dibujar otro tentáculo de la medusa y suelta el botón del ratón para finalizar la pincelada.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.dont-worry-perfect: No te preocupes si no es perfecto, puesto que te enseñaremos a arreglarlo en el siguiente paso.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.reshaping-painterly-brush-stroke: Cambiar la forma de una pincelada de Pincel pictórico
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.painterly-brush-strokes-reshaped: La forma de las pinceladas de Pincel pictórico puede modificarse del mismo modo que una línea, una forma o cualquier otro objeto.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.activate-shape-tool-jellyfish: Activa la herramienta Forma en la caja de herramientas y haz clic en el tentáculo de medusa que dibujaste. Verás pequeños nodos a lo largo del tentáculo.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.nodes-manipulated-with-shape-tool: Estos nodos pueden manipularse con la herramienta Forma para cambiar la forma del tentáculo. Esto funciona con las pinceladas que se han aplicado a objetos (como la curva amarilla), así como con las pinceladas creadas desde cero.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.pick-tool-move-resize-rotate: También puedes usar la herramienta Selección para mover, cambiar de tamaño y girar pinceladas de Pincel pictórico.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.adding-painterly-effects-text: Añadir efectos de Pincel pictórico a texto
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.create-incredible-text-effects-pain: Es posible crear efectos de texto increíbles con la herramienta Pincel pictórico.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.switch-back-painterly-brush: Presiona la tecla de acceso directo J para volver a la herramienta Pincel pictórico.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.click-ola-hello-text: Haz clic en el texto “Ola Bonjour Hello” para seleccionarlo.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.using-property-bar-controls: Usa los controles de la barra de propiedades para:
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.choose-the-fairy-dush-brush: Elegir el pincel Polvo de hadas
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.change-brush-size: Cambiar el tamaño del pincel a 2,54 mm
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-white-swatch-change-col: Haz clic con el botón secundario en la muestra de blanco para cambiar el color.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.mastered-basics-painterly-brush-too: Has aprendido los conceptos básicos de cómo trabajar con la herramienta Pincel pictórico.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.learn-more-about-painterly-brush-to: Obtén más información acerca de la herramienta Pincel pictórico.

PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-tutorial-descriptions: L'outil Pinceau de peintre vous permet de donner vie à vos idées uniques d'une toute nouvelle manière grâce à des styles à base de pixels d'un réalisme impeccable.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.tutorial-will-learn: Au cours de ce didacticiel, vous apprendrez à :
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.use-brush-selector: Utiliser le sélecteur de pinceau et les options associées.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.apply-brush-effects: Appliquer les effets de pinceau de peintre à des courbes.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.create-new-painterly-brush: Créer de nouveaux traits de pinceau de peintre.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.add-painterly-brush-effect: Ajouter les effets de pinceau de peintre à du texte.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.painterly-brushes-effect-curves: Vous pouvez utiliser les pinceaux de peintre pour appliquer des effets aux courbes. Essayez-le !
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.practiec-file-pre-selected-painterl: Dans ce fichier d'entraînement, la courbe jaune est présélectionnée pour vous et l'outil Pinceau de peintre est activé.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.property-bar-brush-selector: La barre de propriétés comporte un sélecteur de pinceau et des commandes pour la taille et la transparence du pinceau.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.applying-painterly-brush-effects: Application des effets de pinceau de peintre
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-selector-dropdown: Commencez par cliquer sur le menu déroulant du sélecteur de pinceau et choisissez le pinceau Fleur de soie. L'effet de pinceau est appliqué à la courbe jaune.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-size-transparency: Ensuite, modifiez la taille du pinceau pour utiliser 0,06 point et la transparence de 20 %.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-color-palette: Cliquez avec le bouton droit de la souris sur l'échantillon de couleur Bleu glaçon dans la palette de couleurs pour modifier la couleur.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.creating-painterly-brush-strokes: Création de nouveaux traits de pinceau de peintre
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.draw-new-brush-strokes: Vous pouvez également peindre de nouveaux traits de pinceau à partir de rien.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.deselect-everything-page: Appuyez sur la touche Échap pour désélectionner tout ce qui se trouve sur la page. Utilisez ensuite les commandes de la barre de propriétés pour :
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.select-silk-flower-brush: Sélectionner le pinceau Fleur de soie.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.set-brush-size: Définir la taille du pinceau sur 0,06 point.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-color-swatch: Cliquez avec le bouton droit sur un échantillon de couleur pour sélectionner une couleur.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.click-drag-jellyfish: Cliquez et faites glisser la souris pour peindre un autre bras de méduse, en relâchant le bouton de la souris pour terminer le trait.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.dont-worry-perfect: Ne vous inquiétez pas si ce n'est pas parfait : nous vous montrerons comment y remédier à l'étape suivante.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.reshaping-painterly-brush-stroke: Retouche d’un trait de pinceau de peintre
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.painterly-brush-strokes-reshaped: Les coups de pinceau de peintre peuvent être remodelés comme vous le feriez avec une ligne, une forme ou un autre objet.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.activate-shape-tool-jellyfish: Activez l'outil Forme dans la boîte à outils et cliquez sur le bras de la méduse que vous avez peint. Vous verrez de petits nœuds sur toute la longueur du bras.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.nodes-manipulated-with-shape-tool: Ces nœuds peuvent être manipulés avec l'outil Forme pour modifier la forme du bras. Cela fonctionne avec les coups de pinceau qui ont été appliqués à des objets (comme la courbe jaune), ainsi qu'avec les coups de pinceau créés de toutes pièces.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.pick-tool-move-resize-rotate: Vous pouvez également utiliser l'outil Sélecteur pour déplacer, redimensionner et faire pivoter les traits créés avec un pinceau de peintre.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.adding-painterly-effects-text: Ajout d’effets de pinceau de peintre à du texte
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.create-incredible-text-effects-pain: Vous pouvez créer des effets de texte incroyables avec l'outil Pinceau de peintre.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.switch-back-painterly-brush: Revenez à l'outil Pinceau de peintre en appuyant sur la touche de raccourci J.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.click-ola-hello-text: Cliquez sur le texte « Ola Bonjour Hello » pour le sélectionner.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.using-property-bar-controls: Utilisez ensuite les commandes de la barre de propriétés pour :
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.change-brush-size: Changez la taille du pinceau sur 0,1 point.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-white-swatch-change-col: Cliquez avec le bouton droit sur l’échantillon de couleur pour changer la couleur.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.mastered-basics-painterly-brush-too: Vous avez maîtrisé les bases de l'utilisation de l'outil Pinceau de peintre.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.learn-more-about-painterly-brush-to: Renseignez-vous davantage sur l’outil Pinceau de peintre.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.get-started-full-cdgs: Lancez-vous avec la version complète de CorelDRAW Graphics Suite. Renseignez-vous.

PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-tutorial-descriptions: Pędzel malarski pozwala realizować wyjątkowe pomysły na nowe sposoby dzięki niezwykle realistycznym, bazującym na pikselach pędzlom.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.tutorial-will-learn: W tym samouczku dowiesz się, jak:
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.use-brush-selector: Korzystać z gamy pędzli i opcji pędzla.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.apply-brush-effects: Stosować efekty pędzla malarskiego do krzywych.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.add-painterly-brush-effect: Dodawać efekty pędzla malarskiego do tekstu.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.painterly-brushes-effect-curves: Możesz korzystać z pędzli malarskich, aby stosować efekty do krzywych. Spróbujmy!
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.practiec-file-pre-selected-painterl: W tym pliku szkoleniowym żółta krzywa została wstępnie zaznaczona, a narzędzie pędzla malarskiego jest już aktywowane.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.property-bar-brush-selector: Pasek właściwości pozwala wybrać pędzel oraz określić jego rozmiar i przezroczystość.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-selector-dropdown: Zacznij, klikając listę rozwijaną wyboru pędzla i wskazując pędzel Jedwabny kwiat. Efekt pędzla zostanie zastosowany do żółtej krzywej.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-size-transparency: Następnie zmień rozmiar pędzla na 0,06”, a przezroczystość na 20%.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-color-palette: Aby zmienić kolor, kliknij prawym przyciskiem myszy próbkę koloru lodowy błękit na palecie kolorów.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.draw-new-brush-strokes: Możesz też rysować nowe pociągnięcia pędzla od zera.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.deselect-everything-page: Naciśnij klawisz Esc, aby usunąć zaznaczenie wszystkich elementów na stronie. Następnie użyj elementów sterowania paska właściwości, aby:
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-color-swatch: Kliknij prawym przyciskiem myszy próbkę koloru, aby go wybrać.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.click-drag-jellyfish: Kliknij i przeciągnij, aby narysować kolejne ramię meduzy. Zwolnij przycisk myszy, aby zakończyć pociągnięcie.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.dont-worry-perfect: Nie przejmuj się, jeśli nie wyszło idealnie – w kolejnym kroku pokażemy Ci, jak sobie z tym poradzić.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.painterly-brush-strokes-reshaped: Pociągnięcia pędzlem malarskim można przekształcać, tak jak linę, kształt, czy każdy inny obiekt.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.activate-shape-tool-jellyfish: Aktywuj narzędzie Kształt z przybornika i kliknij narysowane ramię meduzy. Zobaczysz małe węzły wzdłuż ramienia.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.nodes-manipulated-with-shape-tool: Można nimi manipulować, korzystając z narzędzia Kształt, aby zmienić kształt ramienia. To sprawdza się w przypadku pociągnięć pędzlem, które zostały zastosowane do obiektów (takich, jak żółta krzywa), a także w przypadku pociągnięć utworzonych od zera.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.pick-tool-move-resize-rotate: Możesz także użyć narzędzia Wskaźnik, aby przesuwać pociągnięcia pędzlem malarskim, zmieniać ich rozmiar i obracać je.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.create-incredible-text-effects-pain: Możesz tworzyć niesamowite efekty tekstowe, korzystając z narzędzia Pędzel malarski.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.switch-back-painterly-brush: Wybierz ponownie narzędzie Pędzel malarski, wciskając klawisz skrótu J.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.click-ola-hello-text: Kliknij tekst „Ola Bonjour Hello”, aby go zaznaczyć.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.using-property-bar-controls: Korzystając z elementów sterowania na pasku właściwości:
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-white-swatch-change-col: Kliknij prawym przyciskiem myszy białą próbkę, aby zmienić kolor.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.mastered-basics-painterly-brush-too: Udało Ci się opanować podstawy pracy z narzędziem Pędzel malarski.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.learn-more-about-painterly-brush-to: Dowiedz się więcej na temat narzędzia Pędzel malarski.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.get-started-full-cdgs: Zacznij od pełnego pakietu CorelDRAW Graphics Suite. Dowiedz się więcej.

PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-tutorial-descriptions: Nástroj Malířský štětec umožňuje oživit vaše jedinečné nápady zcela novými způsoby, a to pomocí dokonale realistických pixelových štětců.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.tutorial-will-learn: V tomto kurzu se naučíte, jak:
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.apply-brush-effects: Používat efekty malířského štětce na křivky.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.add-painterly-brush-effect: Doplňovat efekty malířského štětce do textu.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.painterly-brushes-effect-curves: Malířské štětce můžete využít k aplikaci efektů na křivky. Pojďme to zkusit!
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.practiec-file-pre-selected-painterl: V tomto cvičném souboru je předem vybrána žlutá křivka a je aktivován nástroj Malířský štětec.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.property-bar-brush-selector: Panel vlastností obsahuje výběr štětce a ovládací prvky pro velikost a průhlednost štětce.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-selector-dropdown: Začněte kliknutím na rozbalovací nabídku pro výběr štětce a vyberte štětec Hedvábná květina. Efekt štětce se použije na žlutou křivku.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-size-transparency: Potom změňte velikost štětce na 0,06” a průhlednost na 20 %.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-color-palette: Klikněte pravým tlačítkem myši na vzorek barvy Ledově modrá na paletě Barva a změňte barvu.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.draw-new-brush-strokes: Štětcem můžete také dělat úplně nové tahy.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.deselect-everything-page: Stisknutím klávesy Esc zrušíte výběr všech položek na stránce. Potom použijte panel vlastností a:
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-color-swatch: Klikněte pravým tlačítkem myši na vzorník barev a vyberte barvu.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.click-drag-jellyfish: Kliknutím a přetažením nakreslete další rameno medúzy a tah dokončete uvolněním tlačítka myši.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.dont-worry-perfect: Nebojte se, pokud výsledek není dokonalý. V dalším kroku vám ukážeme, jak ho opravit.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.painterly-brush-strokes-reshaped: Tvar tahů malířským štětcem lze měnit stejně jako čáru, tvar nebo jiný objekt.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.activate-shape-tool-jellyfish: Aktivujte nástroj Tvar ze sady nástrojů a klikněte na nakreslené rameno medúzy. Po celé délce ramene uvidíte malé uzly.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.nodes-manipulated-with-shape-tool: S těmito uzly lze manipulovat pomocí nástroje Tvar a měnit tak tvar ramene. To funguje jak u tahů štětcem, které byly použity na objekty (jako je žlutá křivka), tak u tahů štětcem vytvořených úplně od nuly.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.pick-tool-move-resize-rotate: Přesouvat a otáčet tahy malířským štětcem a měnit jejich velikost můžete také pomocí nástroje Výběr.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.adding-painterly-effects-text: Doplnění efektů malířského štětce do textu
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.create-incredible-text-effects-pain: Pomocí nástroje Malířský štětec můžete vytvářet neuvěřitelné textové efekty.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.switch-back-painterly-brush: Stisknutím klávesové zkratky J přepněte zpět na nástroj Malířský štětec.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.click-ola-hello-text: Klikněte na text Ola Bonjour Hello a vyberte jej.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-white-swatch-change-col: Klikněte pravým tlačítkem myši na vzorek bílé a změňte barvu..
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.mastered-basics-painterly-brush-too: Zvládli jste základy práce s nástrojem Malířský štětec.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.learn-more-about-painterly-brush-to: Projděte si další informace o nástroji Malířský štětec.

PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-tutorial-descriptions: 畫匠工法筆刷工具提供十分逼真的像素式筆刷，讓您使用全新方式實現創意巧思。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.tutorial-will-learn: 在本教學課程中，您將學習如何：
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.use-brush-selector: 使用筆刷選取器和筆刷選項。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.apply-brush-effects: 將畫匠工法筆刷效果套用至曲線。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.create-new-painterly-brush: 建立新的畫匠工法筆刷筆觸。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.add-painterly-brush-effect: 為文字添加畫匠工法筆刷效果。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.painterly-brushes-effect-curves: 您可以使用畫匠工法筆刷將效果套用至曲線。我們試試吧！
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.practiec-file-pre-selected-painterl: 在這個練習檔案中，已為您預先選取黃色曲線並啟用畫匠工法筆刷工具。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.property-bar-brush-selector: 屬性列上有筆刷選取器和控制項，可調整筆刷大小和透明度。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.applying-painterly-brush-effects: 套用畫匠工法筆刷效果
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-selector-dropdown: 按一下筆刷選取器的下拉式選單，選擇「絹花」筆刷即可開始。筆刷效果會套用到黃色曲線上。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-size-transparency: 接下來，將筆刷大小變更為 0.06 吋並將透明度設為 20%。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-color-palette: 在色盤上用滑鼠右鍵按一下「冰藍」色彩樣本，即可變更色彩。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.creating-painterly-brush-strokes: 建立新的畫匠工法筆刷筆觸
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.draw-new-brush-strokes: 您也可以從頭開始繪製新的筆刷筆觸。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.deselect-everything-page: 按下 Esc 鍵來取消選取頁面上的所有物件。然後使用屬性列控制項進行以下操作：
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.set-brush-size: 將筆刷大小設為 0.06 吋。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-color-swatch: 用滑鼠右鍵按一下色彩樣本來選取色彩。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.click-drag-jellyfish: 按一下並拖曳以繪製另一個水母觸手，放開滑鼠按鍵即可完成筆觸。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.dont-worry-perfect: 不必擔心筆觸是否完美，我們會在下個步驟展示如何修正。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.reshaping-painterly-brush-stroke: 重新塑造畫匠工法筆刷筆觸
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.painterly-brush-strokes-reshaped: 您可以重新塑造畫匠工法筆刷筆觸，就像重新塑造線條、形狀或其他物件一樣。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.activate-shape-tool-jellyfish: 從「工具箱」啟用「形狀」工具，然後按一下您繪製的水母觸手。您會看到沿著觸手出現的小節點。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.nodes-manipulated-with-shape-tool: 使用「形狀」工具即可操縱這些節點來變更觸手的形狀。這項操作適用於已套用至物件 (例如黃色曲線) 的筆刷筆觸，也適用於從頭開始建立的筆刷筆觸。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.pick-tool-move-resize-rotate: 您也可以使用「選取」工具來移動、調整大小和旋轉畫匠工法筆刷筆觸。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.adding-painterly-effects-text: 為文字添加畫匠工法筆刷效果
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.create-incredible-text-effects-pain: 您可以使用畫匠工法筆刷工具製作一些令人驚豔的文字效果。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.switch-back-painterly-brush: 按下快捷鍵 J，切換回畫匠工法筆刷工具。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.click-ola-hello-text: 按一下「Ola Bonjour Hello」文字加以選取。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.using-property-bar-controls: 使用屬性列控制項進行以下操作：
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.change-brush-size: 將筆刷大小變更為 0.1 吋。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-white-swatch-change-col: 用滑鼠右鍵按一下白色色彩樣本，即可變更色彩。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.mastered-basics-painterly-brush-too: 您已掌握畫匠工法筆刷工具的基本使用方式。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.learn-more-about-painterly-brush-to: 深入瞭解畫匠工法筆刷工具。

PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-tutorial-descriptions: Lo strumento Pennello pittorico ti permette di portare in vita le tue idee uniche in modi innovativi con pennelli perfettamente realistici basati su pixel.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.use-brush-selector: Usare il selettore pennello e le opzioni pennello.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.apply-brush-effects: Applicare gli effetti del Pennello pittorico alle curve.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.create-new-painterly-brush: Creare nuovi tratti con Pennello pittorico.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.add-painterly-brush-effect: Aggiungere gli effetti del Pennello pittorico al testo.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.painterly-brushes-effect-curves: Puoi usare i Pennelli pittorici per applicare effetti alle curve. Proviamo!
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.practiec-file-pre-selected-painterl: In questo file di esercizio, la curva gialla è preselezionata e lo strumento Pennello pittorico è attivo.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.property-bar-brush-selector: La barra delle proprietà include un selettore pennello e controlli delle dimensioni e della trasparenza.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.applying-painterly-brush-effects: Applicazione degli effetti del Pennello pittorico
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-selector-dropdown: Come prima cosa, fai clic sul menu a discesa del selettore pennello e scegli il pennello Fiore di seta. L’effetto del pennello sarà applicato alla curva gialla.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-size-transparency: Quindi, regola la misura del pennello su 0,06” e la trasparenza su 20%.

PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.creating-painterly-brush-strokes: 新しいペインタリー ブラシ ストロークを作成するには

PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.set-brush-size: ブラシの大きさを 0.06” に設定
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-color-swatch: 使いたいカラー サンプルを右クリックすることで色を選択します。

PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.activate-shape-tool-jellyfish: ツールボックスにある形状ツールを有効にし、描いたクラゲの腕をクリックすると、腕に小さいノードが並んでいるのが見えます。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.nodes-manipulated-with-shape-tool: これらのノードを形状ツールを使って操作することで腕の形状を変更することができます。これは、オブジェクトに適用されたブラシ ストロークにも（上述の黄色の曲線のように）、新しく作成したブラシ ストロークにも使える方法です。
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.pick-tool-move-resize-rotate: また、選択ツールを使って、ペインタリー ブラシストロークを移動、サイズ変更、回転させることもできます。

PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-tutorial-descriptions: Met de Painterly-borsteltool kunt u uw unieke ideeën op geheel nieuwe wijze tot leven brengen met ongehoord realistische penselen op pixelbasis.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.tutorial-will-learn: In deze studieles leert u het volgende:
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.painterly-brushes-effect-curves: U kunt de Painterly-borstels gebruiken om effecten op krommen toe te passen. We gaan dit eens proberen.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.practiec-file-pre-selected-painterl: In dit oefenbestand is de gele kromme vooraf geselecteerd. Het Painterly-borstelgereedschap is al geactiveerd.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.property-bar-brush-selector: De Eigenschappenbalk heeft een borstelkiezer en besturingselementen voor de grootte en transparantie van borstels.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-selector-dropdown: Begin door op de vervolgkeuzelijst van de borstelkiezer te klikken en de borstel Zijden bloem te kiezen. Het borsteleffect wordt op de gele kromme toegepast.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.brush-size-transparency: Wijzig de borstelgrootte vervolgens in 1,52 mm en de transparantie in 20%.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-color-palette: Klik op het kleurstaal voor ijsblauw van het kleurenpalet om de kleur te wijzigen.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.draw-new-brush-strokes: U kunt ook nieuwe borstelstreken van voren af aan maken.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.deselect-everything-page: Druk op de Esc-toets om de selectie van alle elementen op de pagina op te heffen. Gebruik vervolgens de besturingselementen op de Eigenschappenbalk om het volgende te doen:
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.set-brush-size: Stel de borstelgrootte in op 1,52 mm.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-color-swatch: Klik met de rechtermuisknop op een kleurstaal en selecteer een kleur.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.click-drag-jellyfish: Klik en sleep om een nieuwe tentakel voor de kwal te maken. Laat de muisknop los om de streek te beëindigen.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.dont-worry-perfect: Maakt u zich geen zorgen als het resultaat niet perfect is. Bij de volgende stap laten we u zien hoe u dat kunt corrigeren.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.painterly-brush-strokes-reshaped: U kunt de vorm van Painterly-borstelstreken net zoals een lijn, een vorm of een ander voorwerp wijzigen.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.activate-shape-tool-jellyfish: Activeer het Vormgereedschap in de Gereedschapskist en klik op de tentakel van de kwal die u zojuist heeft getekend. Er worden nu kleine knooppunten op de tentakel weergegeven.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.nodes-manipulated-with-shape-tool: U kunt deze knooppunten manipuleren met het Vormgereedschap en de vorm van de tentakel wijzigen. Dit werkt met borstelstreken die op voorwerpen zijn toegepast (zoals de gele kromme), maar ook met borstelstreken die u van voren af aan heeft gemaakt.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.pick-tool-move-resize-rotate: U kunt ook het Selectiegereedschap gebruiken om Painterly-borstelstreken te verplaatsen, draaien of het formaat ervan te wijzigen.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.create-incredible-text-effects-pain: U kunt ongelooflijke teksteffecten bereiken met het Painterly-borstelgereedschap.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.switch-back-painterly-brush: Schakel over naar het Painterly-borstelgereedschap door op de sneltoets J te drukken.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.click-ola-hello-text: Klik op de tekst “Ola Bonjour Hello” om deze te selecteren.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.using-property-bar-controls: Gebruik de besturingselementen op de Eigenschappenbalk om het volgende te doen:
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.right-click-white-swatch-change-col: Klik met de rechtermuisknop op het witte kleurstaal om de kleur te wijzigen.
PainterlyBrushToolTutorial.text.mastered-basics-painterly-brush-too: U heeft de basisbeginselen van het werken met het Painterly-borstelgereedschap onder de knie.
